claims.text: Esketamine: depressive Sx in adults w MDD w acute suicidal ideation or behavior, w an oral antidepressant
claims.quote: Depressive symptoms in adults with major depressive disorder (MDD) with acute suicidal ideation or behavior in conjunction with an oral antidepressant.

claims.text: Not shown to prevent suicide or reduce suicidal ideation or behavior
claims.quote: The effectiveness of SPRAVATO in preventing suicide or in reducing suicidal ideation or behavior has not been demonstrated.
